# instudia

> Skill Up for a Better Career in Nagaland.

instudia is the premier skill development and computer training institute located in Dimapur, Nagaland. We focus on practical, project-based learning to bridge the gap between education and employability.

## Complete Course Catalog (19 Courses)

### Technology & Development
- **Programming with Python**: Fundamentals of Python syntax and object-oriented programming.
- **Frontend Web Development**: Mastery of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive design.
- **Backend Web Development**: Server-side scripting, database management, and API development.
- **Fullstack Web Development**: End-to-end development with modern stacks like React and Node.js.
- **Mobile App Development**: Building native and cross-platform apps using React Native.
- **Certificate in DevOps Cloud Services**: Continuous integration, deployment, and cloud automation.
- **Certificate in Data Analytics**: Data processing with Python, SQL, and visualization tools.
- **Certificate in Generative AI**: (Coming Soon) Advanced AI modeling and transformer architectures.
- **Certificate in Hardware and Networking**: PC assembly and network configuration/troubleshooting.

### Finance & Business
- **Accounting in Tally with GST**: Comprehensive GST-compliant accounting and tax filing.
- **Accounting with Tally**: Core financial management and reporting.
- **Certificate in Business Intelligence**: Data visualization and analytics using Power BI.
- **Certificate in Project Management**: Planning, execution, and risk management for modern projects.
- **Certificate in Retail Management**: Customer service, inventory control, and retail operations.

### Design & Creativity
- **Certificate in UI/UX Design Specialization**: User research, prototyping, and user-centered design.
- **Certificate in Graphic Designing**: Visual communication and professional design principles.

### Specialized Diplomas & Skills
- **Diploma in Computer Applications (DCA)**: 6-month foundational diploma for IT proficiency.
- **Post Graduate Diploma in Computer Applications (PGDCA)**: 12-month advanced specialization.
- **Certificate in Advanced Excel**: Mastery of pivot tables, automation, and business intelligence.
- **Certificate in Food Processing**: Practical techniques in food preservation and processing.

## Student Success Tools
- **Salary Insights**: Real-time salary data for tech roles in Nagaland vs National averages.
- **Study Planner**: AI-powered schedule generator to help students manage their learning time.
- **Career Planner**: Step-by-step roadmaps for transitioning into high-paying tech careers.
